search_log: Listed every Apellis filing (all forms) for CIK 0001492422 via data.sec.gov/submissions; the 8-K earnings exhibits (2023-07-31, 2024-02-27) print only total 'Product revenue, net' with no SYFOVRE line, and Apellis filed no earnings 8-K for most quarters, so the SYFOVRE line is read from each 10-Q's net product revenue table and from the 10-K for full-year figures (scripts/apls.py).
Q4 of 2023, 2024 and 2025 derived as full year (10-K) less nine months (Q3 10-Q); no document prints a SYFOVRE fourth-quarter figure.
